package shapes

import "strings"

var limit = 10 * 2

var prefix = "a" + "b"

func Switch(x int) int {
	switch {
	case x > 5:
		return 1
	case x < -5 || x == 0:
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func SwitchTag(x int) int {
	switch x {
	case limit - 1:
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func Closure(s string) bool {
	return strings.IndexFunc(s, func(r rune) bool { return r < '0' || r > '9' }) < 0
}

func IfClosure(s string) bool {
	if n := len(strings.Map(func(r rune) rune { return r }, s)); n > 2 {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func ElseIf(x int) int {
	if x > 100 {
		return 1
	} else if x > 50 {
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func ForCond(n int) int {
	t := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		t += i
	}
	return t
}

func Select(ch chan int) int {
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		return v + 1
	default:
		return -1
	}
}

func Concat(s string) string {
	return prefix + s + "!"
}

func Multi(a, b int) int {
	return a*
		b + 1
}

func Defer(x *int) {
	defer func() { *x = *x * 2 }()
	*x = *x + 1
}

func Label(n int) int {
	c := 0
outer:
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		if i > 3 {
			break outer
		}
		c++
	}
	return c
}

func call(f func(), ok bool) bool { f(); return ok }

func callAfter(ok bool, f func()) bool { f(); return ok }

func ArgsLitFirst(a, b int) bool {
	return call(func() {}, a < b)
}

func ArgsLitAfter(a, b int) bool {
	return callAfter(a < b, func() {})
}

func BreakFirst(n int) int {
	c := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		if i == 2 {
			break
		}
		c++
	}
	return c
}

func Send(ch chan int, v int) {
	select {
	case ch <- v + 1:
	default:
	}
}

func TypeSwitch(x any) int {
	switch v := x.(type) {
	case int:
		return v * 2
	}
	return 0
}

func RangeLit(n int) int {
	t := 0
	for _, v := range func() []int { return []int{n, n} }() {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func PlainElse(x int) int {
	if x > 0 {
		return 1
	} else {
		return x - 1
	}
}

func Negate(y int) int {
	x := -y
	return x
}

func DeferArgs(n int) (out int) {
	defer func(a int) { out = a }(n + 1)
	return 0
}

func ForLitCond(n int) int {
	c := 0
	for i := 0; i < func() int { return n }(); i++ {
		c++
	}
	return c
}

func _() {
	x := 1 + 2
	_ = x
}

func RangeHeader(xs []int, n int) int {
	t := 0
	for _, v := range xs[n-1:] {
		t = t + v
	}
	return t
}

func RangeLitBody(n int) int {
	t := 0
	for _, v := range func() []int { return []int{n} }() {
		t = t + v
	}
	return t
}

func id(f func(), a any) any { f(); return a }

func TypeSwitchLit(a any) int {
	switch x := id(func() {}, a); v := x.(type) {
	case int:
		return v * 2
	}
	return 0
}

func run(f func()) { f() }

func ClauseLitEarlier(n, a, b int) bool {
	switch n {
	case 1:
		run(func() {})
		return a < b
	}
	return false
}

func IfLitInit(n int) int {
	if f := func() int { return n }; f() > 0 {
		return n - 1
	}
	return 0
}
